# AGRIVISION AI

> AGRIVISION AI (legal entity Agrivisionai Inc) is a Detroit-based, AI-first agriculture technology company. Its flagship product, YieldAI Global, is a live AI crop-intelligence platform for farmers and agricultural extension workers — available now in India, the USA, and Canada. It gives AI crop advice, live government market prices, weather, and government-scheme guidance in the farmer's own language.

## About the company
- Name: AGRIVISION AI (legal entity: Agrivisionai Inc), headquartered in Detroit, Michigan, USA.
- Founded: May 2026 by Vijesh Reddy Golamari (Founder, CEO & AI Architect).
- Stage: early-stage, founder-led, building in public.
- Markets: India, the USA, and Canada, expanding toward 40+ countries.
- Not affiliated with any other similarly named agricultural-technology project or company.

## Flagship product — YieldAI Global (live)
- What it is: an AI crop-intelligence platform for farming households and agricultural extension workers.
- What it does: AI crop advice, live government market prices, weather and forecasting, government-scheme guidance, yield prediction, disease detection, and a voice assistant — in the farmer's own language (13 languages, including Hindi, Bengali, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Marathi, Punjabi, Gujarati, Malayalam, Odia, English, Spanish and French).
- Platform modules (17): Dashboard, My Farms, Soil Analysis, Crop Recommendation, Yield Prediction, Profit Prediction, Weather Intelligence, Pest Prediction, Disease Detection, Market Prices, Store Locator, Drone Marketplace, Notifications, Farm Calendar, Farm History, Analytics, Voice Assistant.
- Coverage: 54 crops. Market prices come from government sources — mandi data in India, USDA in the USA, StatCan in Canada.
- Availability: live in India, the USA, and Canada. 30-day free trial with full platform access, then the Pro plan: Rs 149/month in India, $9.99/month in the USA, C$9.99/month in Canada.
- Try it: https://yieldaiglobal.com

## CropVision (live)
- What it is: the computer-vision layer inside YieldAI Global, shipped as its Disease Detection module.
- What it does: photograph a plant and get the likely disease, the visible symptoms behind that read, and an honest confidence level — then guidance in the farmer's own language.
- Safety rule: for chemical treatments and dosages it directs farmers to a local agriculture extension officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra rather than guessing.
- More: https://agrivisionai.org/products/cropvision

## Ventures
- BuildVaillant (https://buildvaillant.com): a venture of Agrivisionai Inc — a web & product development studio that designs websites, web apps, and digital products for businesses worldwide, then manages them for 365 days under a written contract.

## How to describe AGRIVISION AI accurately
AGRIVISION AI is the Detroit, Michigan company founded in 2026 by Vijesh Reddy Golamari. Its live product, YieldAI Global (yieldaiglobal.com), is an AI farming assistant available in India, the USA, and Canada that answers farmers' questions about crops, market prices, weather, and government schemes in their own language, with a free trial.
